newsitem.title: USA: Compass sets central Texas acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Compass sets central Texas acquisition.

text.p: Compass Bancshares Inc said Thursday it agreed to acquire Greater Brazos Valley Bancorp Inc and its subsidiary, Commerce National Bank, for undisclosed terms.

The transaction is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to close during the first quarter of 1997. It will add $61 million in assets, $58 million in deposits and two locations to Compass' Texas franchise.
Compass said it will add Commerce National Bank's locations in College Station and Bryan, Texas, noting the area has about 135,000 residents.
It is also home to Texas A&M University with its more than 43,000 students as well as major research and development centers.
